Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
di=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); do=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
H,W=di.shape
# demo: color5 changed -> check what distinguishes the 5-object. It has no adjacent non-bg colors, doesn't touch border, enclosed by bg.
# maybe rule: object surrounded only by background gets recolored to ... hmm.
# Check other objects enclosed by bg too
enclosed=[]
for v in [1,4,6]:
    for cc in comps_of(di,8,v):
        ys=[p[0] for p in cc]; xs=[p[1] for p in cc]
        enc=all(di[y,x]==8 for y in range(max(ys)-1,min(ys)) if False) 
        # check neighbors of whole bounding box perimeter are bg or same
        enc=True
        for y in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1):
            for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1):
                for dy,dx in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if not(0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W): enc=False; break
                    if di[ny,nx]!=8 and di[ny,nx]!=v: enc=False; break
                if not enc: break
            if not enc: break
        enclosed.append((v,len(cc),enc,(min(ys),max(ys)),(min(xs),max(xs))))
print('objects enclosed by bg:', enclosed)

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
d1i=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); d1o=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
d2i=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']); d2o=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])
ti=np.array(G['Test input'])

def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if seen[y,x]: continue
                    seen[y,x]=True; cells.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny,nx]!=bg and not seen[ny,nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(list(cells))
    return out

def solve(g):
    bg=Counter(v for r in g.tolist() for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=g.shape
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    ch=[c for c in cs if int(g[c[0][0],c[0][1]])!=bg]
    touchers=[c for c in ch if min(p[0] for p in c)==0 or max(p[0] for p in c)==H-1 or min(p[1] for p in c)==0 or max(p[1] for p in c)==W-1]
    src_color=tgt_color=None
    # source: largest non-touching comp
    nontouch=[c for c in ch if c not in touchers]
    source=max(nontouch,key=len)
    tgt_color=int(g[touchers[0][0][0],touchers[0][0][1]])
    o=[row[:] for row in g.tolist()]
    for (y,x) in source:
        o[y][x]=tgt_color
    return o
print('d1 match:',solve(d1i)==d1o.tolist())
print('d2 match:',solve(d2i)==d2o.tolist())
out=solve(ti)
print(json.dumps(out))

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if seen[y,x]: continue
                    seen[y,x]=True; cells.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny,nx]!=bg and not seen[ny,nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=np.array(G[name+' input']); go=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    H,W=gi.shape
    ch={(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if gi[y,x]!=go[y,x]}
    bg=Counter(v for r in gi.tolist() for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(gi,bg)
    tgt=int(go[next(iter(ch))])
    touchers=[c for c in cs if int(gi[list(c)[0]])==tgt]
    markcomp=touchers[0]
    mkc=[m for m in touchers][:1]; mcells=list(markcomp)
    for idx,c in enumerate(cs):
        v=int(gi[list(c)[0]])
        mn=(min(q[0] for q in c),min(q[1] for q in c))

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter

def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if seen[y,x]: continue
                    seen[y,x]=True; cells.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny,nx]!=bg and not seen[ny,nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if seen[y,x]: continue
                    seen[y,x]=True; cells.add((y,x))

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter,deque,defaultdict
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if seen[y,x]: continue
                    seen[y,x]=True; cells.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny,nx]!=bg and not seen[ny,nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
for n in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); go=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    H,W=gi.shape
    bg=Counter(v for r in gi.tolist() for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ch={(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if gi[y,x]!=go[y,x]}
    cs=comps(gi,bg)
    bycolor=defaultdict(list)
    for idx,c in enumerate(cs):
        col=int(gi[min(c)])
        bycolor[col].append(idx)
    changed=next(i for i,c in enumerate(cs) if c&ch)
    col_old=int(gi[min(cs[changed])]); col_new=Counter(int(go[p]) for p in ch).most_common(1)[0][0]
    print('=== demo%d'%n,'col',col_old,'->',col_new)
    sizes=[(c,len(cs[c])) for c in bycolor[int(gi[min(cs[changed]])])]
    # all comps of same color sorted by size
    samecol=[(len(cs[i]),cs[i],int(gi[min(cs[i]]))) for i in bycolor[col_old]]
    samecol.sort(key=lambda t:(-t[0],min(t[1])))
    for s_,cc,col in samecol:
        mark='*CHANGED' if set(cc)==set(ch) else ('NEAR'+str(min(abs(a-p)+abs(b-q) for a,b in cc for p,q in ch) if False else ''))
        dist=min((abs(a-p)+abs(b-q) for a,b in cc for p,q in ch),default=99)
        print('  sz%02d size%s pos%s'%(s_,'' if 'CHANGED' in mark else '', (min(cc)), mark if 'CHANGED' in mark else ('dist %d'%dist if dist<80 else '')))

def load():
